title: Anthropic Acquires Confidential AI Startup Opaque Systems
description: Anthropic has acquired Opaque Systems, a startup specializing in confidential AI technology that enables AI systems to use sensitive data securely by leveraging hardware-based protections. Opaque Systems also expanded its work to verifiable AI, providing cryptographic evidence of AI system behavior to replace trust assumptions. The acquisition includes Opaque's team joining Anthropic, with Opaque winding down its operations. The impact on existing customers has not been disclosed. This announcement is a security-industry news event rather than a vulnerability or exploit.
aiSummary: Opaque Systems developed technology for confidential AI that protects sensitive data using hardware security features and extended this to verifiable AI, which cryptographically verifies AI system behavior and policy adherence. The company was acquired by Anthropic, with its team joining Anthropic and its operations winding down. The acquisition aims to advance confidential and verifiable AI research and deployment. No specific security vulnerabilities or exploits are described in this announcement.
aiImpact: There is no direct security vulnerability or exploit reported. The acquisition may influence the development and deployment of confidential and verifiable AI technologies, potentially improving AI security and trustworthiness. No immediate impact on security posture or risk is indicated for users or customers.
